filler_traps._comment: Using values here let you set a 'recommended' filler_trap percentage or even a default percentage

description: Choose how many Shadaloo Emblems are required for Shadaloo Emblem goals.
This can be set from 1 to 100, or randomized in the YAML for a surprise objective.
Shadaloo Emblems are only added to the item pool when the selected goal requires them.
Controls how many Shadaloo Emblem items are placed compared to the required amount.
100 means only the required amount is placed. 200 means double the required amount is placed.
For example, 25 required tokens with 200 percent will place 50 Shadaloo Emblems in the item pool.
The final amount is capped at 100 Shadaloo Emblems.
